raw.description:
About AIChE

AIChE, founded in 1908, is a professional society of more than 60,000 chemical engineers in 110 countries. Its members work in corporations, universities, and government, using their knowledge of chemical processes to develop safe and useful products for the benefit of society. AIChE fosters and disseminates chemical engineering knowledge, assists the professional and personal growth of its members, and applies the expertise of its members to address societal needs and improve the quality of life. Through its varied programs, AIChE continues to be a focal point for information exchange on the frontiers of chemical engineering research in such areas as energy, sustainability, biological and environmental engineering, nanotechnology, and chemical plant safety and security.

The RAPID Manufacturing Institute, part of the Manufacturing USA network, operates out of AIChE, in partnership with the Department of Energy (DOE), as a collaborative technology ecosystem (development, scale-up, education) to enable the transformation of the process industries for a decarbonized, energy and capital efficient future further advancing U.S. manufacturing competitiveness.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, smart, and visionary Executive Director (ED) to lead the RAPID Advancement in Process Intensification Deployment (RAPID) Manufacturing Institute. The ED will develop and implement a long-term vision for RAPID, structure and grow the team to meet this vision, oversee the management of the team and the operations of the institute.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a long-term growth strategy that ensures RAPID's sustainability, industry relevance, and continued impact beyond current funding cycles.
  • Serve as the primary external ambassador for RAPID, building relationships with senior leaders across industry, government, academia, and the Manufacturing USA network.
  • Identify and secure new funding opportunities, strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and revenue-generating initiatives to support RAPID's mission and growth.
  • Provide visionary leadership to position RAPID as the national leader in process intensification, advanced manufacturing innovation, and related workforce development activities.
  • Partner with the RAPID Governing Board and Executive Committee to establish strategic priorities, evaluate organizational performance, and guide long-term decision-making.
  • Lead organizational growth and transformation efforts, ensuring RAPID has the structure, talent, and capabilities necessary to achieve its strategic objectives while fostering a culture of respect, integrity and collaboration.
  • Monitor emerging trends in manufacturing, energy, technology, and federal policy to proactively identify opportunities, risks, and competitive advantages for RAPID and its stakeholders.
  • Establish key performance indicators and success metrics across financial performance, membership growth, project impact, stakeholder engagement, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Ensure alignment of new projects and existing activities with RAPID’s strategic plan and long-term vision.
  • Participate with AIChE leadership to ensure consistency of strategy and practices across AIChE and RAPID.

Competencies:

  • Strategic Visioning & Planning – Develop and execute a long-term strategy for RAPID’s growth and impact.
  • Stakeholder Engagement – Build and strengthen partnerships with industry, government, and academia.
  • Organizational Leadership – Scale RAPID by structuring teams, optimizing operations, and driving growth.
  • Financial Management – Oversee budgets, secure funding, and allocate resources strategically.
  • Policy & Government Relations – Navigate government partnerships, funding, and regulatory landscapes.
  • Technology & Innovation – Align RAPID’s portfolio with emerging industry trends and needs.
  • Change Management – Lead through industry and institute shifts, ensuring adaptability and competitiveness.
  • Executive Governance – Guide RAPID’s Boards and Executive Committee to ensure strategic alignment.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or related discipline required, with MS or PhD preferred.
  • Prior success in growing a small company or business unit by creating stakeholder value and managing a highly skilled team
  • Experience managing large project teams, business units, or a small business
  • Organized and strategic thinker who can move from ideation through to execution
  • Ability to translate broad goals into achievable steps, anticipate and solve problems, and take advantage of opportunities.
  • Ability to motivate and enable others to work toward a shared vision
  • Collaborative mindset
  • Willingness to listen to the opinions and perspectives of others
  • Knowledge of, and experience with, the Dept. of Energy and the Manufacturing USA Institutes
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written).

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage
  • Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, and personal days
  • Retirement plan with employer matching contributions
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare and Dependent Care)
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement and professional development support

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 , commensurate with experience.

Work Environment

This is a demanding position which requires a personal commitment to the missions of AIChE and the DOE’s CMEI office, and the ability to handle a diverse project load. The position may be fulfilled via telecommuting by a candidate with demonstrated ability to work across geographic boundaries with multi-location teams. The position is expected to require 20–30% travel.

The American Institute of Chemical Engineers is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Senior Product Manager

Company Overview

ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition. We provide marketers the products they need to acquire qualified customers at scale. Our platform is trusted by thousands of companies engaged in direct-to-consumer marketing, helping them save wasted spend, comply with ever-changing regulations, and manage a constantly evolving partner landscape. Our flagship product, TrustedForm is used to certify over 1 billion opt-in digital customer leads every year and is the gold standard for documenting prior express written consent for TCPA compliance. We’re shaping the future of lead generation — and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help lead the next chapter.

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager, you will own the product strategy for the ActiveProspect platform. You will work closely with executive leadership, product managers, customers, design, engineering, and go-to-market teams to identify high-impact opportunities, define clear product direction, and deliver solutions that drive measurable business value.

This role is ideal for a commercially minded product leader who thrives in both strategy and execution. You should be comfortable moving from customer discovery and market analysis to roadmap planning, feature scoping, experiment review, launch support, and outcome measurement.

We are looking for someone who has worked in high-quality marketing technology, advertising technology, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign automation, workflow automation, or similar SaaS environments. The ideal candidate has experience with products that include creation workflows, rules or automation engines, collaboration, analytics, integrations, and clear ROI measurement.

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and articulate the vision, strategy, and roadmap for lead management and distribution, ensuring alignment with company objectives and market opportunities.
  • Translate business goals into product priorities, balancing long-term vision with iterative value delivery.
  • Drive Go-to-market decision making to ensure business goals from product releases are achieved.
  • Quantify and model opportunity sizes to inform investment decisions and sequencing.
  • Lead cross-functional planning and ensure resources are focused on the highest-impact initiatives.
  • Partner with leadership to define pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies for your domain.
  • Leverage AI to accelerate product development workflows, including research, PRD development, prototyping, analysis, and experimentation.

Customer & Market Insights

  • Maintain a deep understanding of both lead buyers and sellers, speaking regularly with customers to uncover pain points and opportunities.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable strategies and feature development.
  • Stay informed on competitor trends, compliance regulations, and technology advancements influencing the lead ecosystem.
  • Ensure the voice of the customer is central to product decisions and trade-offs.
  • Build customer feedback loops, including a customer advisory board, to continuously validate product direction.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Define and own the core business metrics for your product area, including lead volume, quality, conversion, yield, and ROI.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure success.
  • Collaborate with analytics teams to establish clear KPI tracking and visibility for leadership.
  • Incorporate experimentation and testing frameworks to evaluate product improvements and GTM effectiveness.

Execution & Product Management

  • Drive high-quality, predictable delivery in partnership with engineering and design.
  • Lead scoping sessions and manage prioritization across multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
  • Ensure new capabilities are launched with clear success criteria, tracking, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Client Success to plan GTM launches and customer onboarding that deliver measurable business impact.
  • Maintain accountability for results and continuous improvement after release.

Collaboration & Accountability

  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, client success, sales, and finance to achieve shared goals.
  • Act as the central point of contact for your product area, ensuring clear communication of priorities, progress, and outcomes.
  • Foster alignment and transparency across teams; proactively surface risks and trade-offs.
  • Represent your product domain in company-wide planning, portfolio reviews, and leadership updates.

Leadership & Employee Engagement

  • Demonstrate full ownership from problem identification through solution delivery and adoption.
  • Mentor and support Associate PMs or peers in discovery, prioritization, and customer engagement.
  • Model urgency, accountability, and customer obsession consistent with company values.
  • Contribute to a culture where team members feel engaged, challenged, and recognized for delivering impact.

What You Bring

  • 5–8+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, Marketing Tech, or Lead Management environment
  • Track record in executing product launches that have direct impact on business outcomes.
  • Deep experience building and optimizing web-based applications with complex UI workflows, ensuring intuitive and high-performing user experiences.
    • While this role interfaces with backend and data systems, it is not an API or infrastructure PM role.
  • End-to-end ownership: proven success owning a roadmap, defining metrics, and managing for ROI.
  • Strong customer empathy and experience conducting customer research and validation.
  • Demonstrated ability to size opportunities, make data-driven tradeoffs, and build business cases for investment.
  • Hands-on experience defining and executing GTM strategy (launch plans, pricing, packaging, and adoption).
    Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with financial models, performance dashboards, and experimentation frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; can influence across teams and levels.
  • Experience with lead management, distribution, or marketing automation is a plus.
  • Experience with AI tools include Claude Code and Claude Design

Benefits and Perks

  • A collaborative work environment with the freedom and opportunities of a startup culture
  • A global, remote-first company that encourages occasional team get-togethers
  • Life and work balance
  • Flexible vacation time
  • Retirement plan matching up to 3% of your salary
  • Varied options for health, dental, vision, disability and life insurance

raw.description:
About Us
Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen.

About the Role
The Director of International Operations and Logistics leads the strategy, execution, and optimization of Comfrt's international operations across all non US markets, ensuring every customer receives a seamless, on brand experience regardless of geography. This role owns international fulfillment, cross border freight, duties and compliance, carrier performance, and market expansion readiness, partnering across Operations, CX, Finance, and Tech to unlock profitable growth in Canada, UK/EU, APAC, and new markets. By translating global complexity into structured, scalable playbooks, this role directly supports revenue growth, margin protection, and long term customer loyalty outside of the US.

Organisational Contribution & Influence

The Sr Director, International serves as the connective tissue between US HQ and Comfrt's international 3PL, freight, and carrier network. This role partners closely with DC Operations, CX, Planning, Finance, Tech, and Legal/Compliance to ensure SLAs, landed cost, duties, and brand standards are upheld in every market we ship to. By maintaining strong visibility across international KPIs and providing timely, structured updates to leadership, this role drives alignment on priorities, surfaces risks early, and ensures customer feedback and market nuances are integrated into operational decisions. Through consistent communication and cross functional leadership, the position reinforces a culture of global consistency, operational excellence, and customer first thinking that extends beyond any single region.

Key Responsibilities

1. International Operations Strategy & Execution (30%)

  • Own the end to end international operations strategy across fulfillment, freight, duties, and returns for all non US markets.
  • Define and manage SLAs, cost to serve targets, and service standards by market aligned to business goals.
  • Build and maintain international playbooks that enable scale, consistency, and structured execution across regions.
  • Drive readiness for new market launches, including 3PL selection, carrier negotiation, routing, tax/duty setup, and go live planning.

2. 3PL, Freight & Carrier Management (25%)

  • Manage international 3PL and freight partners, holding them accountable to contracted SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards.
  • Lead carrier selection, RFPs, rate negotiations, and ongoing performance reviews to optimize speed, cost, and customer experience.
  • Oversee cross border freight lanes, middle mile consolidation, and last-mile partner performance across key regions.
  • Create contingency plans for peak, weather, and geopolitical disruptions to ensure consistent delivery performance.

3. Compliance, Duties & Landed Cost (15%)

  • Own DDP vs DDU strategy, HS code accuracy, and duty/tax compliance across all shipping regions in partnership with Finance and Freight teams.
  • Partner with Tech and Finance to ensure accurate duty calculation at checkout and minimize post-purchase surprises for customers.
  • Monitor regulatory changes (e.g., de minimis, VAT/IOSS, import rules) and adapt processes proactively.
  • Own landed cost modeling, identifying margin opportunities and cost leakage across markets.

4. Cross Functional Collaboration & Alignment (15%)

  • Partner with CX, Planning, Merchandising, Marketing, and Tech to align international priorities with company initiatives.
  • Represent international ops in strategic planning, promotional calendars, and cross-departmental projects.
  • Provide timely, structured communication and reporting across stakeholders and leadership.

5. Data, Reporting & Insight (10%)

  • Analyze shipping cost, on-time delivery, cancellation, and returns metrics by market to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Partner with reporting teams to produce actionable dashboards and insights for leadership.
  • Translate data into structured reporting frameworks that inform market level decisions and investment.
  • Own the cadence and communication of international ops reporting to executive leadership.

6. Team Leadership & Development (5%)

  • Lead, coach, and develop the international ops team, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Build succession planning and skills development to maintain high performance across regions.
  • Organize team structures, meeting cadences, and coverage plans to maximize productivity across time zones.

Skills & Experience

  • Min 7+ years of progressive experience in international ecommerce operations, global logistics, cross-border freight, or supply chain.
  • Proven track record leading international 3PL, carrier, and freight partner relationships at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cross border duties, taxes (VAT/IOSS), customs, and DDP/DDU strategy.
  • Experience launching new international markets end to end (systems, carriers, compliance, launch planning).
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience owning landed cost, cost to serve, and margin levers.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel/Sheets; comfort with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and OMS/WMS platforms.
  • Experience working in a high growth ecommerce or retail environment; Shopify experience a plus.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team development skills with a track record of building high performing global teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence across regions and time zones.

Qualities & Attributes

  • Global minded operator who can balance big picture strategy with day to day execution.
  • Structured thinker who turns ambiguity into repeatable playbooks.
  • Data driven decision maker who uses insight to guide investment and prioritization.
  • Strong commercial instincts and comfortable owning P&L impacting decisions.
  • Calm under pressure, especially during peak trade periods and cross border disruptions.
  • Proactive problem solver who anticipates risks before they impact the customer.
  • Collaborative partner who builds trust quickly across regions, functions, and partners.

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Der Deutsche Maklerverbund ist eine bundesweite Plattform sowie Einkaufs- und Interessengemeinschaft für Versicherungsmakler und Finanzvermittler, die ihren Mitgliedern sowohl stark wettbewerbsfähige Produkte, Courtagen und innovative Prozesse als auch Unabhängigkeit bietet. Mit Blick auf die Digitalisierung entwickeln wir die Maklersoftware Professional works und stellen sie unseren Mitgliedern zur Verfügung. Wir lösen damit das Problem des digitalen Rückstands in der Versicherungs- und Finanzwelt mit intelligenten Softwarelösungen, tragen zur Transparenz bei und verbessern die Kundenorientierung und Schnelligkeit in Beratungs- und Verwaltungsprozessen.

Seit zehn Jahren wächst der Unternehmens-Umsatz jährlich um ca. 30 %. Da wir ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen sind, können wir unsere Ziele und Visionen konsequent verfolgen. Die Kombination aus einem finanziell soliden Unternehmen und der Unternehmenskultur eines Start-Ups führt zu Kreativität und hoher Motivation bei den Mitarbeitern. Und unsere Kunden sind Makler und Vermittler, die unsere Visionen teilen. Nun suchen wir dich!

DeineAufgaben

Rund 150 Versicherungsmakler beantragen jeden Monat einen Testlogin beim Deutschen Maklerverbund. Viele davon entscheiden sich für die Zusammenarbeit. Wir wollen die neuen Mitglieder bestmöglich unterstützen – und dafür brauchen wir dich!

Das von uns entwickelte und in der Branche vielfach ausgezeichnete Maklerverwaltungsprogramm Professional works bildet die technische Basis, um den Verwaltungsaufwand zu reduzieren und die Beratung zu digitalisieren. Unsere Mitglieder benötigen Hilfestellung, um die innerbetrieblichen Abläufe zu optimieren und mittels Professional works durchzuführen. Das heißt im Einzelnen:

  • Betreuung von Maklern (vom Einzelkämpfer bis zum Großmakler), die ihr Unternehmen digitalisieren wollen bzw. müssen.

  • Qualifizierung und Beratung der Makler in unserem digitalen Maklerverwaltungsprogramm durch Telefonate, Online- und Offline- Schulungen sowie Webkonferenzen

  • Ausbau der Makler- und Partnerbeziehungen auch in Hinblick auf unsere hervorragenden Courtage- und Produktmodelle

  • Eigenverantwortliche Planung und Steuerung der Betreuungstätigkeiten

Requirements

Wir wünschen uns

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Versicherungsbereich (§34 d Gewerbeordnung)

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits bei einem Versicherungsmakler/Maklerpool/Versicherer/Vertrieb gearbeitet

  • IT-DNA und gute Auffassungsgabe, um komplexe, digitale Themen schnell zu erfassen und unseren Mitgliedern zu vermitteln

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Selbstorganisationsfähigkeiten

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, überdurchschnittlicher Qualitätsanspruch und die Lust, etwas zu erreichen

raw.title: Senior Principal Engineer, AI & Business Transformation
raw.excerpt: Who is Forcepoint? Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments.
raw.description:
Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

Forcepoint's operating model hasn't kept pace with the business — accumulated approval layers, fragmented process ownership, and substantial AI-driven efficiency left unrealized. The AI & Business Transformation function exists to close that gap through a continuous loop: sense where the business is costing money or slowing down, redesign those processes end-to-end, and deliver them as AI-driven workflows on the Forcepoint Intelligence Platform.

The Senior Principal Engineer sits at the intersection of business intent and engineered outcome. Day-to-day, that means partnering closely with the VP to sequence and deliver the transformation portfolio; co-architecting the agentic delivery layer with the CIO and platform engineering team; aligning on data foundations and benefits realization with the CFO and Finance; coordinating workforce impact and AI Ambassador adoption with the CHRO; ensuring security, governance, and auditability with the CISO; and working directly with functional and business-unit leaders who own the processes targeted for transformation.

This role is the most senior technical authority in this function — an individual-contributor reporting to the VP, AI & Business Transformation, with no direct reports and enterprise-wide scope. Influence is exercised through architecture, invention, and technical judgment. This person sets the technical vision across all three pillars of the loop: the data foundation that enables sensing, the process architecture that guides redesign, and the agentic systems and tooling that deliver transformation at scale.

The platform foundation is already in place — the Forcepoint Intelligence Platform is live, with MCP connectors to core business systems, a growing library of production agents, and AI Ambassadors embedded across every function. The transformation portfolio covers high-value flows including customer deprovisioning, renewal forecasting, quote-to-cash, lead-to-opportunity, and SKU creation. What's missing is the senior technical authority to make the whole loop compound: turning point solutions into a coherent, reusable agentic system that gets faster and smarter with every flow it redesigns.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Technical Vision

  • Set the cross-pillar technical vision. Own the end-to-end architectural vision that connects sensing, redesign, and delivery into a single compounding loop — ensuring the data foundation, process designs, and agentic systems reinforce one another rather than fragmenting into disconnected point solutions.
  • Architect the agentic delivery layer. Define how redesigned processes become production-grade AI agents, Skills, and tooling on the Forcepoint Intelligence Platform — establishing the reference architecture, orchestration patterns, exception-handling models, and human-in-the-loop standards the broader organization builds against.
  • Build AI-first capability on AWS and Bedrock. Establish the cloud and model foundation on AWS and Amazon Bedrock — delivering model access, agent orchestration, and platform services that are scalable, observable, and cost-efficient, while keeping the architecture model-flexible enough to adopt the strongest models as the landscape evolves.

2. Process Redesign & Delivery

  • Translate process redesign into engineered outcomes. Partner with functional leaders and transformation owners to take flagged, re-architected flows and turn them into automated, governed, observable systems — owning the technical design from contract-end trigger through cross-system orchestration to benefits realization.
  • Prove value through visible wins. Identify and deliver high-leverage quick wins that build organizational confidence, then convert them into durable, scalable architecture — balancing near-term proof with long-term platform coherence.

3. Data, Measurement & Governance

  • Strengthen the sensing foundation. Shape the data architecture, KPI instrumentation, and benefits-realization tracking that let the organization measure whether redesigned work actually moved a number — reconciled with Finance and built on the enterprise data platform.
  • Drive technical governance for AI. Partner with platform, security, and legal stakeholders to define how AI is applied responsibly across elevated flows — covering model selection, data handling, auditability, and the governance thresholds that keep enterprise-scale automation safe and compliant.

4. Standards, Patterns & Organizational Capability

  • Establish reusable standards and patterns. Create the frameworks, accelerators, and engineering operating mechanisms that make each successive flow faster to deliver than the last, raising the bar for quality, reliability, and velocity across the transformation portfolio.
  • Act as a force multiplier. Mentor engineers, AI Ambassadors, and functional teams; codify best practices; and elevate the collective technical capability of the organization — multiplying impact through influence and invention rather than direct headcount.

5. How You'll Work

This role is intentionally high-leverage, not high-headcount. The Senior Principal Engineer operates as an individual contributor with enterprise-wide technical authority and a mandate that extends across every function in the transformation portfolio.

  • Work through functional leaders, transformation owners, and embedded engineering teams — aligning and accelerating execution through technical credibility and demonstrable results.
  • Partner closely with the VP, AI & Business Transformation, Leadership Team, and the CIO to drive technical priorities across the enterprise.
  • Build reusable architecture and engineering patterns that compound across regions, functions, and future transformation initiatives.
  • Act as a technical mentor and force multiplier — building the AI-first engineering capability of the organization through standards, coaching, and hands-on example.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and outcome-based engineering execution.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years in software engineering, architecture, or platform development, with a sustained track record of operating at the most senior technical levels (Principal, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or equivalent) and influencing outcomes across an enterprise rather than a single team.
  • Demonstrated mastery of enterprise, application, and data architecture — including designing systems that span multiple business domains, integrate disparate platforms, and operate reliably at scale.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in AI-first and agentic engineering — designing and delivering production systems built around LLMs, agents, and orchestrated tooling, not merely experimenting with them. Proven ability to move agentic work from proof-of-concept to dependable, governed production.
  • Proven experience translating complex, cross-functional business processes into engineered systems — re-architecting end-to-end flows and the data, integration, and automation that make them run.
  • Deep, hands-on command of AWS — including Amazon Bedrock for model access and agentic delivery — and modern platform engineering: scalability, performance, observability, and cost optimization at enterprise scale.
  • A history of measurable business impact: compressed delivery cycles, material cost reduction, productivity multipliers, or revenue enablement attributable to technical leadership.
  • Exceptional ability to influence without authority — aligning functional leaders and engineering teams around a shared technical direction through credibility and clarity rather than reporting lines.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to move between executive business framing and deep technical detail.
  • A rare dual-altitude capability — able to engage senior stakeholders clearly on transformation strategy, then stay genuinely hands-on, personally shaping architecture and building alongside engineers to deliver real, measurable results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Granted patents or other recognized technical invention demonstrating original contribution to the field.
  • Experience instrumenting enterprise KPI frameworks and benefits-realization tracking in partnership with Finance.
  • Background spanning regulated or security-conscious environments, with fluency in governance frameworks (ITIL, ISO, or equivalent).
  • Experience building or scaling internal developer platforms, MCP-style connector ecosystems, or reusable Skills/agent libraries.
  • Track record establishing engineering operating mechanisms and metrics-driven practices (e.g., DORA) that durably raise reliability and velocity.
  • Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience operating across globally distributed teams and multi-region delivery.

About Forcepoint

Forcepoint enables Self-Aware Data Security, an AI-native approach that helps enterprises and governments know their data everywhere, adapt to evolving risks and regulations in real time, and protect at scale with a unified, single-policy framework. Based in Austin, Texas, Forcepoint creates safe, trusted environments for customers and their employees in more than 150 countries.

Forcepoint is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range and variable compensation for this role is230,000.00 - 250,000.00 and represents the low and high end of compensation for this position. Actual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to, location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Forcepoint’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include bonuses, paid time off policy, and many region-specific benefits

Don’t meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don’t meet all requirements listed in a job posting. Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team.

The policy of Forcepoint is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Forcepoint is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to recruiting@forcepoint.com.

Applicants must have the right to work in the location to which you have applied.

Title: Manager, Benefits & Compensation
Reports to: Director, Total Rewards
Location: This role will be remote in the continental US, Alaska, or Hawaii
FLSA Status: Exempt
Hours: Full-time
Union Status: Non-Union
Salary Range: $85,000–$100,000

Summary:
The Benefits & Compensation Manager is a key operational role on Trevor's Total Rewards team, responsible for the day-to-day administration, integrity, and continuous improvement of Trevor's benefits, compensation, and recognition programs. Reporting to the Director, Total Rewards, this manager will translate Trevor's evolving Total Rewards strategy into well-run programs that employees experience as accessible, equitable, and reflective of Trevor's mission and values.

This role is both highly hands-on and meaningfully strategic, operating across a fully-remote workforce comprised of union and non-union staff, and 24/7 shift workers. The Benefits & Compensation Manager will own the administration of Trevor's health, welfare, retirement, wellness, and leave programs; partner with the Director on compensation cycles, market benchmarking, and pay equity analysis; and serve as a trusted point of contact for employees navigating their benefits, leaves and accommodations, and pay. As Trevor cultivates its Total Rewards philosophy and implements new initiatives, the Benefits & Compensation Manager will play a central role in operationalizing those changes with care, accuracy, and clarity.

The Benefits & Compensation Manager will also serve as the back-up to the Senior Payroll Manager, providing payroll administration support during peak cycles, absences, or coverage needs. While deep payroll expertise is not required, familiarity with payroll fundamentals and a willingness to learn Trevor's payroll operations are essential.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, mission-aligned, and energized by the opportunity to strengthen the employee experience through thoughtful program administration, clear communication, and continuous improvement.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Benefits Administration & Strategy
  • Administer the day-to-day operations of Trevor's benefits programs — including health insurance, retirement plans, wellness programs, voluntary benefits, and employee perks — ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and a high-quality employee experience
  • Partner with the Director, Total Rewards to evaluate, evolve, and continuously improve benefits offerings to align with Trevor's Total Rewards philosophy and the needs of a diverse, distributed workforce comprised of both union and non-union employees
  • Lead the annual benefits open enrollment process, including planning, employee education, vendor coordination, system configuration, and execution
  • Manage relationships with benefits providers, brokers, and external consultants to ensure responsive service, plan integrity, and strong vendor performance
  • Support benefits initiatives and changes in partnership with the Director, Total Rewards
  • Serve as a key point of contact for employee benefits inquiries, providing clear, empathetic, and timely communication that helps staff understand and access the full value of their benefits
  • Develop and promote wellness initiatives that align with Trevor's commitment to mental health, total wellbeing, and inclusion, ensuring underutilized resources become visible and accessible to staff
Compensation Administration & Analysis
  • Partner with the Director, Total Rewards to operationalize Trevor's compensation strategy, including the annual compensation cycle, merit and increase administration, and recognition programs aligned to Trevor's performance, compensation, and promotion cycle timelines
  • Support the analysis, maintenance, and ongoing refresh of Trevor's pay bands and job architecture, contributing to job evaluations, classifications, and leveling consistency across the organization
  • Conduct salary and labor market research, prepare benchmarking analyses, and participate in compensation surveys for competitive and equitable pay practices as needed
  • Support pay equity audits, internal equity reviews, and compensation reporting as needed to inform decision-making at the Director and CPO level
  • Partner with Director of Total Rewards and other People Team members to provide guidance on offers, promotions, and pay decisions
Recognition & Rewards
  • Support the design, launch, and ongoing administration of Trevor's employee recognition programs, partnering with the Director, Total Rewards and the Director, Talent & Inclusion to ensure recognition reflects Trevor's values and culture
  • Administer recognition workflows, employee communications, and reporting to ensure those programs are consistently and equitably applied across the organization
Leave & Accommodations
  • Administer Trevor's leave and accommodations programs across multiple states, including FMLA leave, state-specific leave, and ADA and religious reasonable accommodations
  • Partner closely with People Business Partners, Legal, and other People team members to ensure leave and reasonable accommodations are administered with consistency, equity, and care for all Trevor employees
  • Maintain accurate documentation, tracking, and reporting on all leave and reasonable accommodation cases
Compliance & Reporting
  • Ensure benefits programs comply with all federal, state, and local regulations, including ERISA, ACA, FMLA, COBRA, HIPAA, and other applicable laws
  • Support Trevor's benefits and compensation compliance and audit-readiness framework, proactively managing Form 5500 filings, ACA reporting, nondiscrimination testing, pay transparency reporting, and benefits-related audits in partnership with the Director, Total Rewards
  • Maintain accurate employee data across HRIS and vendor systems, conducting routine audits to ensure data integrity
  • Reconcile benefits invoices, identify discrepancies, and partner with vendors to drive timely resolution and payment processing
Payroll Administration (Back-Up Support)
  • Serve as the designated back-up to the Senior Payroll Manager, providing coverage during peak cycles, absences, and time-sensitive payroll needs
  • Support biweekly payroll processing in ADP Workforce Now, including timesheet review, deduction validation, and audit checks during back-up coverage
  • Partner with the Senior Payroll Manager to ensure benefits-related payroll inputs (deductions, retirement contributions, leave coding) are accurate and timely
Cross-Functional Partnership & Operations
  • Partner closely with the Director, Total Rewards, the Senior Payroll Manager, People Business Partners, People Operations, Internal Communications, Legal, and Finance to ensure Total Rewards programs are well-coordinated, well-communicated, and well-governed
  • Contribute to the development of clear documentation, employee-facing communications, and internal playbooks that build sustainable, scalable Total Rewards processes
  • Demonstrate fair, ethical, and equitable business practices; handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion and integrity
  • Demonstrate a commitment to fostering and maintaining an environment of inclusion and belonging, modeling Trevor's values in everyday interactions and operational initiatives
  • Approach all work and interactions with empathy and inclusion, to create relationships with teams and individuals at all levels, working closely with colleagues to brainstorm ideas, discuss pros/cons, and develop ways forward, listening and responding to develop mutual understanding and trust
  • Communicate clearly - both in written and verbal form - for internal audiences, distilling complex information into compelling, easily digestible narratives; conveying information around policies, legal and compliance considerations, and best practices in a way that is understood by staff at all levels
  • Work collaboratively with relevant external partners
  • Maintaining knowledge competency relating to The Trevor Project’s programs, services, and strategic goals, as well as the LGBTQ+ community we serve
  • Handle matters with regard for cultural, operational, and legal considerations
  • Learn eagerly, share knowledge appropriately, and improve continuously
  • Demonstrate successful planning and problem-solving skills, including multitasking and working well within tight timelines
  • Demonstrate attention to detail and accuracy in all work
  • Handle other relevant duties and responsibilities as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of progressive experience administering employee benefits and compensation programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, wellness initiatives, and leave policies
  • Strong working knowledge of ERISA, ACA, FMLA, COBRA, HIPAA, and other federal, state, and local regulations governing benefits and compensation
  • Experience supporting compensation cycles, including market benchmarking, salary surveys, job evaluations, and pay equity analyses
  • Experience administering leave and accommodations across multiple states, including ADA and mental-health-related accommodations
  • Familiarity with payroll fundamentals and willingness to serve as back-up to a Senior Manager, Payroll; hands-on payroll processing experience is a plus but not required
  • Experience working with benefits providers, brokers, and external consultants to evaluate, implement, and continuously improve benefits offerings
  • Ability to administer and communicate benefits and compensation programs with an emphasis on inclusivity, accessibility, equity, and employee wellbeing
  • Ability to analyze benefits and compensation data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations
  • Ability to explain complex benefits and pay information in a clear, empathetic, and engaging manner to employees at all levels
  • Experience with HRIS and benefits administration platforms (ADP Workforce Now experience preferred)
  • Experience operating within a unionized environment, including 24/7 shift-based staff
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong emotional intelligence, integrity, discretion, and ability to build trust across diverse teams and stakeholders
  • Demonstrated commitment to fostering inclusive, equitable, and mission-aligned workplace practices
  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English
  • Experience supporting Total Rewards within global or internationally distributed organizations is preferred
  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus

Data Scientist

Revenue Analytics is a SaaS company that helps companies make better revenue decisions in pricing, products, and promotions. Our analytics solutions drive measurable revenue uplift and help customers move faster with more confidence.

Founded in 2005, we combine deep expertise in pricing and revenue management with modern software, machine learning, and AI to power complex commercial decisions. In Hospitality, we are building products that help redefine what modern revenue management looks like — turning advanced analytics into practical product capability for hotel operators navigating pricing, demand, and competitive complexity.

This Data Scientist position represents a unique opportunity to join a growth-stage company that is investing aggressively in the future of hospitality revenue management. We are looking for someone excited by that opportunity and motivated to help build real product capability, not just one-off analysis.

As a Data Scientist, you will help build machine learning and AI systems that power our hospitality analytics platform. You will work on revenue management and pricing problems in a complex, fast-moving domain, partnering closely with product, science, and engineering to turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analytical solutions. Your work will directly influence product direction and help hospitality customers make better, faster, more data-driven decisions.

What You Will Do:

  • Build machine learning and AI solutions that support pricing, forecasting, and revenue management decisions in hospitality.
  • Analyze large, sometimes messy datasets to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities, and turn them into practical recommendations or product capability.
  • Write clean Python and SQL, working with data pipelines and analytical workflows to prepare, validate, and operationalize data.
  • Apply modern AI techniques, including LLMs and AI coding tools such as Claude Code, thoughtfully to accelerate prototyping, learning, and development while maintaining technical quality.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical solutions and communicate insights clearly.

What You Will Bring:

  • 0–2 years of experience in data science, analytics, machine learning, or a related field, including internships, research, senior projects, or meaningful independent projects.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in statistics, mathematics, operations research, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field.
  • Hands-on coding experience in Python, working knowledge of SQL, and familiarity with modern data analysis and machine learning workflows.
  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems, choose sensible analytical approaches, and explain trade-offs, limitations, and recommendations clearly.
  • Strong curiosity, ownership, and learning agility, with interest in hospitality, travel, pricing, forecasting, or other business problems where analytics can directly influence outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with revenue management, pricing, forecasting, segmentation, or related analytical problem spaces.
  • Experience building something reusable or scalable, such as a data pipeline, internal tool, model workflow, or decision-support analysis.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, business intelligence tools, or modern AI tooling in technical workflows.

This role oversees Customer Success Ops Enablement, Education, and Services. The VP will lead the strategy, delivery, and optimization of customer-facing enablement and service offerings (including Customer Education, Training, Internal Learning & Enablement, and Customer Success Transformation), while also leading strategic initiatives, championing digital transformation, and managing the internal operations/technology roadmap for the Customer Success team.

Reporting to the SVP, Customer Success, this role is critical to maximizing customer time-to-value, adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success while ensuring operational excellence across the departments.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a unified strategy for Customer Success Operations, Enablement, and Services aligned with company goals for retention, adoption, and growth.

  • Lead digital transformation initiatives across the customer lifecycle — leveraging AI, automation, and analytics to enhance both internal productivity and customer service delivery..

Customer Enablement & Services

Customer Success Operations & Insights

  • Lead process re-engineering and optimization efforts across CS workflows, from internal team enablement to customer onboarding/adoption journeys, to ensure maximum efficiency and scalability.

People Management and Internal Enablement

Revenue & Financial Management

  • Collaborate with Finance and CS leadership to forecast revenue, resource needs, and operational expenses across CS functions.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:

About the Role

Idea Entity, LLC is looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 developer to support and extend our Finance & Operations (F&O) and Project Operations environments on a flexible, part-time basis. Eligibility Requirements

Nice to Have

  • X++ development experience within F&O.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are seeking a Vice President, Consultant Relations to join our Revenue leadership team. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer and leading a high-performing team of 7, you will own the end-to-end consultant relations strategy to eliminate barriers to mental health. This is a full-time, remote position that requires significant travel, typically 4 to 6 times per quarter, to engage with consulting partners and attend industry events.

What you’ll do

  • Build and execute a consultant relations strategy that drives Spring Health awareness and advocacy across the employer and Health Plan healthcare benefit space
  • Lead and develop a team of 7 Strategic Alliances directors and senior managers by providing clear feedback and guidance that enables growth
  • Drive pipeline growth through targeted strategies and deep partnerships with national and regional benefits consulting firms
  • Educate the market by building high-level relationships with leaders across top-tier consulting firms
  • Partner with internal marketing to execute targeted consultant campaigns, sponsorships, and events
  • Collaborate with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on our shared mission
  • Provide competitive intelligence and consultant viewpoints to internal stakeholders to inform product and growth roadmaps
  • Create an environment of psychological safety and trust where your team can debate ideas and learn from mistakes
  • Translate company strategy into clear goals and success criteria for the Alliances team
  • Manage team capacity and remove obstacles to ensure sustainable, high-bar performance

What success looks like in this role

  • Achieve a specific percentage increase in qualified pipeline generated through consultant channels within the first fiscal year
  • Meet or exceed annual New Bookings targets attributed to Strategic Alliance partnerships
  • Maintain high team engagement and retention scores as measured through quarterly engagement surveys
  • Establish formal partnership status or preferred provider recognition with at least two of the top three national consulting firms
  • Successfully integrate consultant feedback into the product roadmap, resulting in at least two major feature or service enhancements

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of leadership experience in a healthcare or benefits environment
  • Proven track record of leading teams focused on large/jumbo employer clients
  • Deep existing relationships and credibility across top national benefit consulting firms
  • Expertise in navigating complex, rapidly changing environments with a strong bias toward action
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to practice candor with care in high-stakes negotiations
  • Strong analytical rigor and a data-driven approach to identifying market opportunities
  • Authentic alignment with our mission to eliminate every barrier to mental healthcare

The target salary range for this position is $225,000-$257,500and is part of a competitive total rewards package including equity and benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using Radford Global Compensation Databaseat minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay.

Benefits provided by Spring Health:

Note: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medicalaccounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.
  • Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning
  • A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.
  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays.
  • At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non-birthing parents.
  • Access to Noom, a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals.
  • Access to fertility care support through Carrot, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.
  • Access toWellhub, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription
  • Access to BrightHorizons, which provides sponsored child care, back-up care, and elder care
  • Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year.
  • $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes.

Job Description: Project Manager

Role Type: Remote (With occasional travel requirements)

Employment Type: FTC (18 months)

JOB SUMMARY

Founded in 2007, First Intuition Limited Group (FI) is an award-winning, UK-based provider of predominantly accountancy training and apprenticeships. We currently have ~ 500 staff based across 8 physical locations and remotely, but we continue to grow rapidly. In April 2023, we secured investment from the private equity firm Apiary Capital who continue to support us in our growth plans, including two recent acquisitions of other First Intuition franchises.

Our success is due to our approach to training and our links with businesses. We work closely with organisations to precisely understand their needs and incorporate these into innovative course designs, where the interaction with students is tailored, personal and reflects their specific circumstances.

We consider ourselves a national provider with locally held relationships. This enables us to deliver student focussed programmes and build strong relationships with all our clients, big or small. With a talented team, we are dedicated to fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture that supports both personal and professional growth and were recently voted as one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024.

This role is being created to further support and enhance the continued growth within FI Ltd group. It is critical to our business model that our UK/central teams work in unison with our centres to continue to deliver a fantastic service for our students, clients, and our teams. To achieve this, we are seeking a highly skilled project manager to work within the FI Ltd group providing project management oversight to various pieces of work. The successful candidate will have an opportunity to work across different areas of the business, focussing on improving efficiencies and delivering solutions.

This role is critical to our success over the next 3-5 years and will work across all areas of the FI Ltd group. We’re looking for a solution-focussed individual with an ability to look at things differently, who has a deep understanding of the student journey.

THE ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Project planning including defining the project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  2. Allocate project resources, including team members, budgets, and equipment.
  3. Develop detailed project schedules and work plans.
  4. Identify potential risks and create mitigation strategies.
  5. Communicate with stakeholders regularly and provide details project updates to various stakeholder groups.
  6. Find solutions to improve efficiency across business functions.
  7. Drive continuous improvement plans for systems and technology.
  8. To use data insights to drive further business plans and support business decisions.

REPORTING CHAIN AND TASKING

You will report directly to the Director of Strategic Planning and Project Delivery, who will be your main point of contact. You will accept day to day tasks from other staff members as per processes agreed.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is predominantly home-based with occasional travel to any of the FI Ltd or wider FI network locations. Volume of travel will be dependent on project schedule.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Essential:

  • Experience in implementing enterprise systems across business areas including finance.
  • Knowledge of project governance and reporting requirements.
  • Proven experience as a project manager.

Desirable:

  • Proficiency in project management software.
  • An understanding of the accountancy education industry
  • Experience of project managing finance system implementation.
  • Proficiency in project management software.

Skills:

  • Excellent organisational, planning, prioritisation, and time management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and environments.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks at once.
  • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills.
  • Relationship building and ability to work collaboratively with people at all levels of the organisation.
  • Consistency and attention to detail in all written work.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate information.
  • Ability to work well in a team as well as independently

Benefits

  • 30 days annual leave (based on full time hours) PLUS bank holidays
  • 3 Fl Days per year
  • Hybrid working available, equipment provided for homeworking
  • Flexible-working positive employer with a range of family-friendly policies
  • Employee Assistance Programme: 24-hour confidential access to counselling and support services
  • Competitive Pension
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Long term career prospects in a growing company

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionFirst American Bank was founded in Chicago, and over the years has expanded throughout Wisconsin and Florida.
raw.description:
Job Description

First American Bank was founded in Chicago, and over the years has expanded throughout Wisconsin and Florida. As the largest privately held bank in Illinois, we now have over 60 locations and assets of $8+ billion. We are a community bank at heart with international expertise, traditional values, and a forward-looking philosophy. Our employees have the experience and vision to meet the needs of savers, borrowers, and businesses in the 21st century. First American Bank can offer employees a level of visibility, career growth, and stability that is difficult to find in many larger corporations.

The Debit Card Dispute Specialist hourly (non-exempt) position investigates and resolves debit card and Zelle disputes by researching and monitoring cases to ensure Regulation E compliance, reviewing chargeback statuses, and handling unposted cardholder items. Additionally, this position monitors a variety of reports and performs general research tasks related to debit card operations.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITES

  • Investigate and resolve debit card disputes by researching and monitoring cases while ensuring Regulation E compliance is met. Review reports for chargeback statuses. Research cardholder unposted items and prepare checks as needed.

  • Comply with REG E, MasterCard rules, Network rules, and internal policies and procedures.

  • Process Zelle dispute claims. Ensure claims are processed according to all policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

  • Prepare the MasterCard Billing Reports (MCB).

  • Prepare end-of-the-month status reports.

  • Monitor the Account Data Compromise alerts. Warm cards that were reissued due to the alerts.

  • Perform general research tasks related to debit card operations as needed.

  • Conduct and complete additional assignments/projects as designated by management.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum one year of experience in banking or bank-related field required.
  • Previous experience in debit/credit card operations and balancing/account reconciliation preferred.
  • Must be professional, comfortable speaking with external and internal contacts with a demonstrated ability to tailor the message appropriately to the audience and situation effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to convey thoughts and ideas effectively and succinctly via written formats, including emails, letters, and electronic platforms. Maintain professional standards relating to spelling and grammar.
  • Maintain credibility through professional demeanor, appearance, and presence by modeling standards appropriate to our environment and industry.
  • Maintain good working relationships with internal partners by exhibiting exemplary interpersonal skills, adopting a constructive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Use sound professional judgment to balance the interests of the organization and customer, understanding and using available resources to mitigate risks.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 products and applications, including the ability to effectively prepare or review documents, procedures, and reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems and applications, as well as the ability to understand, adapt and adjust responsibilities/workflows as a result of system upgrades.
  • Occasional travel to other First American Bank locations, Bank functions, and training facilities may be required.
  • Typical schedule is Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours may be required depending upon business need.
  • Punctuality is required to maintain First American Bank’s customer service standards.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

With Piper the #1 AI SDR Agent now an official part of the Salesforce family, we need a sharp, versatile PMM who can do it all, from arming sellers with battle-tested enablement materials, to sharpening our cross-cloud positioning.

This is a true jack-of-all-trades role. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing, and your work will directly impact how thousands of Salesforce sellers understand and sell Qualified.

Why Qualified

NovaKid is a global leader in online English education for children aged 4–12, serving 100000+ students across 50+ countries.

We’re now looking for a Kid’s Products Design Lead to define and drive the creative quality of our children’s learning experience across multiple products.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine creative vision, team leadership, operational excellence, and innovation. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of animators, sound designers, artists and designers responsible for creating engaging lesson content art, self-learning products and creative assets for our kids area features.

You’ll play a central role in shaping a cohesive, distinctive, and scalable visual identity across our product ecosystem, ensuring our interfaces and ked-facing designs align with our brand and create a consistent, high-quality experience for children.

We’re also looking for someone with strong practical knowledge of AI-powered creative tools who can champion their adoption across the team, helping us work smarter, move faster, and deliver outstanding assets with speed and consistency.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of animators, sound designers, UX/UI designers and artists

  • Set the creative direction for lesson content art and kids area features based on user needs and best practices

  • Drive the unification of design across multiple products to strengthen brand consistency

  • Build clear standards, workflows, and quality benchmarks for asset production

  • Champion the use of AI tools for asset creation to improve efficiency, scalability, and turnaround times

  • Explore and embed new creative technologies that enhance team output without compromising quality

  • Partner closely with Product and Content teams to bring ideas to life

  • Provide clear feedback and creative leadership to ensure a consistently high bar for output

  • Balance creativity, quality, speed, and business priorities in a fast-moving environment

  • Help shape the future of the kid-facing design function through strong planning, structure, and team development

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years experience in a senior UX/UI Design role within product, animation, gaming, edtech, children’s media, or a related field

  • Proven success leading and developing multidisciplinary creative teams

  • Strong expertise in art direction, visual storytelling, animation production, and digital asset creation

  • A strong eye for brand, with experience creating consistency across multiple products or platforms

  • Competent knowledge of AI tools for creating visual and/or audio assets, with the ability to apply them in practical, high-value ways

  • Experience championing new tools, workflows, and ways of working that improve speed and efficiency

  • Excellent planning, prioritisation, and stakeholder management skills

  • Confidence working cross-functionally with both creative and non-creative partners

  • A passion for creating joyful, imaginative, high-quality experiences for children

What we offer:

  • Fully remote work.

  • A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education.

  • A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products.

  • Unlimited holidays – because we trust you to deliver.

  • Bonuses and stock options – we grow together.

A Day in the Life

  • Proficient in all areas of sleep study including calibration, monitoring, measurement, documentation and treatment (PSG, PAP Titration, CO2 Monitoring, Oxygen Administration, etc.)
  • Score the polysomnogram and generate reports summarizing sleep/wake period, REM episodes, arousal analysis, EEG phenomena, cardiac events, respiratory events, limb movements, and other physiological events according to current AASM guidelines noted in adults, children and infants.
  • Troubleshooting of HSAT problems as well in center equipment
  • Assists with sleep center new employee orientation as directed
  • Responsible for supply inventory maintenance in the absence of the Manager.

What’s Required

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Highly Preferred: BRPT/NBRC/ABRET:

  • Registered by the Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists (BRPT) (RPSGT) OR
  • Registered by the National Board of Respiratory Care (NBRC) with some sleep experience preferred OR
  • Registered by the American Board of Registration of Electroencephalographic and Evoked Potential Technologists (ABRET) with some sleep experience preferred.

  • Basic computer skills

Are you Munson Material? Apply today!

More Than Just Care, It’s Community

Imagine doing meaningful work in a place where people vacation. That’s life at Munson Healthcare - northern Michigan’s largest healthcare system, with eight award-winning community hospitals serving over half a million residents across 29 counties.

If you want a career in healthcare and a lifestyle most people only dream about – with freshwater lakes, scenic trails, charming downtowns, a vibrant arts scene, and endless outdoor adventures - you might just be Munson Material. To us, that means teammates who live by our values of excellence, teamness, positivity, creativity, and a commitment to creating exceptional experiences for our patients and each other. Join a team that delivers outstanding care in one of the most beautiful regions in the country.

Invested in You

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Consultant für Firewall- und Netzwerksicherheit, der unsere Kunden von der

fachliche Verantwortung für das Thema Netzwerksicherheit: Du entwickelst Lösungsdesigns und übergibst
diese strukturiert an unser Projektteam und begleitest es bis zum Abschluss.

  • Architektur & Design: Du verantwortest das High-Level- und Low-Level-Design für komplexe Firewall und Security-Infrastrukturen vorwiegend im Enterprise- und gehobenen Mittelstandsumfeld
  • Workshops & Presales: Du leitest technische Workshops, führst Proof of Concepts (PoCs) durch und unterstützt unseren Vertrieb aktiv in der Presales-Phase (Sizing, Aufwandsschätzungen, Lösungspräsentationen)
  • fachlicher Lead: Du agierst als fachlicher Ansprechpartner und Eskalationsstufe (3rd) für komplexe Security-Herausforderungen und begleitest unsere System Engineers bei kritischen Rollouts

dein profil

deine zukunft bei uns im unternehmen

Warum bei uns? Was dich erwartet:

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering-Teams zusammen, die deine Designs im Projekt umsetzen – inkl. direkter Abstimmung im Alltag
  • Die fachliche Führung kommt selbst aus der Praxis – daher bekommst du schnelle Entscheidungen und wenig unnötige Abstimmungen
  • Du hast direkten Einfluss auf unsere Architekturstandards und bringst eigene Ideen in Angebot und Portfolio ein
  • Wir investieren kontinuierlich in deinen Expertenstatus durch Weiterbildungen und den Ausbau deiner Hersteller-Zertifizierungen (Palo Alto, Sophos, Fortinet)
Wir bieten Dir spannende Aufgaben in einem attraktiven und abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsumfeld:
  • Team: Der Zusammenhalt innerhalb unseres vielseitigen Teams zeichnet uns durch hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, Team- und Firmenevents sowie ein familiäre Arbeitsatmosphäre aus
  • Modern Workplace: Am Arbeitsplatz der Zukunft erhältst Du neuestes Technikequipment und arbeitest in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Flexibilität: Je nach Aufgabengebiet und in Abstimmung mit Deiner Führungskraft besteht die Möglichkeit, Deine Arbeitszeit und Deinen Arbeitsort individuell anzupassen
  • Abwechslung: In Deinen eigenverantwortlich geführten Projekten kannst Du unsere vielfältigen Kunden kennenlernen und erhältst Einblicke in die unterschiedlichsten Branchen
  • Weiterentwicklung: Mit einem umfangreichen Angebot, individueller Karriereplanung, Herstellerzertifizierungen und vielem mehr, entwickelst Du Dich kontinuierlich weiter und bleibst niemals stehen
  • Benefits: mit einer Vielzahl von Benefits wie z.B. Firmenfitness, Job-Rad, Gesundheitsmanagement, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie Leasingoptionen von PC, Laptop und/oder Smartphone für Dich und Deine Familie
Du hast Lust gemeinsam mit uns unser Team weiter aufzubauen und dessen Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann sollten wir uns unbedingt kennenlernen - wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for experienced full-stack engineers to join teams across Figma’s Growth and Monetization Engineering organization! This group spans several teams—including Growth, Billing, Enterprise, and Discovery—each focused on solving complex challenges that help millions of users, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, get the most out of Figma. Depending on the team, you might design billing infrastructure at global scale, build secure enterprise access systems, improve how users discover and organize their work, or drive product-led growth and monetization initiatives.

As part of these teams, you’ll design and scale reliable, secure, and intuitive systems that power collaboration across Figma’s product suite. Playing a key role in driving our rapid growth, global expansion, and evolving product surface area—while working closely with cross-functional partners to ensure our technology meets the needs of our most sophisticated customers.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Design, build, test, and ship high-quality features across the stack, using technologies like TypeScript, React, Ruby, Go, C++, and more.
  • Own key parts of the product that impact user experience, internal productivity, or revenue operations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners in product, design, data science, support, and sales to shape product direction and solve complex problems.
  • Operate and monitor the systems you build, with a strong focus on reliability, security, performance, and user experience.
  • Contribute to team culture by mentoring peers, providing feedback, and helping foster a collaborative and inclusive engineering environment.

We’d Love to Hear From You If You Have:

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and maintaining complex systems or products in production.
  • Full-stack experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) and back-end technologies (e.g., Ruby, Python, Go, PostgreSQL).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working effectively across functions.

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, billing/payments infrastructure, developer platforms, or enterprise-scale systems.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as Stripe, Salesforce, NetSuite, Snowflake, SCIM, SAML, or WebAssembly.
  • A background in experimentation, observability, compliance automation, or internal tools development.
  • Prior work on extensibility platforms (plugins, APIs, widgets), or experience contributing to open source developer communities.
  • Passion for crafting excellent developer or user experiences, and an eye for elegant, maintainable architecture.
  • Enthusiasm for learning and teaching—whether mentoring teammates, leading initiatives, or sharing knowledge in code reviews or pairing sessions.
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location by a factor of between 80% and 100% of range. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

Figma offers equity to employees, as well a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental & vision, retirement with company contribution, parental leave & reproductive or family planning support, mental health & wellness benefits, generous PTO, company recharge days, a learning & development stipend, a work from home stipend, and cell phone reimbursement. Figma also offers sales incentive pay for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. Figma’s compensation and benefits are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

$153,000—$376,000 USD

  • 6–12 months: Predictable revenue engine, multiple reference customers, clear plan for scaling the team

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 6–12+ years in B2B SaaS revenue roles with full-cycle closing experience
